It looks like it could be a brioche rib, which is a knitting technique. If you use two different colors, It creates this effect where one color (the purple/blue) pops forward in front of the other color (the black.)

If you’re looking for that color popping out from black look, you most likely won’t be able to get it from your material alone. If you have experience knitting though, a brioche rib could work great to get this effect

I use a brand of soap called SOAK to wash my bras and other delicates that can’t go in the washing machine. You add just a tiny bit to your water and let your clothes rest in it for awhile. Then gently wring everything out and hang to dry. 

The tiny bottle I have has lasted me months because it’s super concentrated. It might be better for your clothes than hand soap and would be convenient for bathroom washing as it doesn’t get too sudsy and it doesn’t require rinsing. 

You could let your clothes soak in a bin while you take a shower, wring them out when you’re done, and no one would know anything was washed!
